facts.fact: Ecomatin reports the e-Tax software was recently made operational for tax declaration and payment from 22 March 2025, per the finance minister.
Ecomatin states customs operations were digitised in 2024 through the operational Sydonia software, which it credits with raising customs revenue from 10% to 25%.

CAF.note: The document mentions fibre and 4G poor connectivity but no rural programme count or rural/urban survey split.

facts.fact: Ecomatin reports that since 22 March 2025 all tax declaration and payment operations are meant to be done online through the e-Tax platform, as the finance minister says.
Ecomatin reports that from 22 March 2025 tax declaration is done online (telefiling) on the e-Tax platform, per the finance minister.
Ecomatin reports that from 22 March 2025 tax payment is meant to be made online (telepayment) through e-Tax.

CAF.note: No share of returns filed online is given.
